paper_id: Automated Commit Message Generation with Large Language Models_ An Empirical Study and Beyond
title: Automated Commit Message Generation with Large Language Models: An Empirical Study and Beyond
motivation: 现有CMG数据集质量差，导致无法客观评估模型性能；实践中commit消息质量普遍低下
problem_framing: 将CMG问题定义为：生成包含What（代码变更内容）和Why（变更原因）的高质量commit消息
key_insight: MCMD数据集中的ground truth本身缺少What/Why信息，GPT-3.5生成的消息反而更完整
method_signature: ERICommiter：两步过滤+语义/词法检索的ICL框架
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: LLM倾向于传达更多What信息，但因代码上下文有限而缺乏Why细节
evidence_for_taste: ground truths themselves are inherently flawed
lacking critical What and Why information
highly effective and efficient LLM-based CMG approach
slightly weaker than that reported in the original paper
thinking_moves: 通过pilot analysis发现数据集质量导致评估异常，而非模型能力不足
从实践角度定义good commit message应包含What和Why两个维度
三层筛选机制构建高质量测试集：自动过滤→Bi-LSTM预筛→人工精选
引入Cohen's kappa系数验证人工评估的信度
比较自动化指标与人工评估的差异，揭示指标局限
借鉴 retrieval-augmented在CMG任务中的成功，设计ICL框架
